# Physiquinator

Offline workout tracker with rest timer, history, and AI assistant. Data stays on device.

- Home: https://physiquinator.pages.dev/
- History: https://physiquinator.pages.dev/history
- Plans: https://physiquinator.pages.dev/plan
- Settings: https://physiquinator.pages.dev/settings
- Privacy: https://physiquinator.pages.dev/privacy

Source: https://github.com/kadato/Physiquinator
Manifest: https://physiquinator.pages.dev/manifest.json
Sitemap: https://physiquinator.pages.dev/sitemap.xml

The browser demo keeps per-browser SQLite with a 20-second autosave. It installs as an offline PWA. Clearing site data deletes your training data. Export a backup from Settings regularly. The WASM host has no /mcp endpoint. The self-hosted Web build exposes 15 agent tools at /mcp over Streamable HTTP.
